description: This PHP class 'UrlSigner' creates signed URLs for Amazon CloudFront resources, supporting different URL schemes and handling URL signing logic.

classes.name: UrlSigner
classes.description: A class for generating signed URLs for Amazon CloudFront, supporting different URL schemes and policies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UrlSigner with key pair ID and private key for signing URLs.

methods.name: getSignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a signed URL for CloudFront, optionally with expiration and custom policy.

methods.name: createRtmpUrl
methods.description: Generates a relative RTMP URL for Flash players.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates a resource string based on URL scheme, handling http, https, and rtmp schemes.
